name: Coordinate a multi-casualty response
short_description: Direct initial layperson actions for a simulated incident involving at least five casualties until professional responders arrive.
self_assessment: I can coordinate initial actions for five simulated casualties without help until professional responders arrive.
description: Direct initial layperson actions for a simulated incident involving at least five casualties until professional responders arrive. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
safety_note: Real emergencies can overwhelm untrained responders; ensure scene safety, call emergency services, use layperson first aid, and hand control to professionals promptly.
